pr_metadata.title: CI: Reshuffle perf steps a bit to better utilize workers
pr_metadata.description:
Move the network latency test onto the same worker as the throughput test, and split the snapshot tests across two workers, to optimize pipeline runtime by loading all workers roughly equally.

gold_comments.evidence_requirement: The added line at .buildkite/pipeline_perf.py:40 uses a space to separate two test targets in test_path, which may not be supported by the test runner.
gold_comments.rationale: A space delimiter in test_path is ambiguous and may cause the test runner to misinterpret the path or fail to execute both tests, leading to incomplete performance coverage.
